verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a cloud file-conversion service that handles user files, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only file deletion and expiry controls. Those are adjacent data-retention features, not a documented commitment or control preventing user data from being used to train AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
